paragraphs.text: Days 1–3    La Candelaria and Monserrate · the Salt Cathedral

Day 2 · Breakfast, then a private city tour of La Candelaria, Bogotá’s historic centre (6 hours) with an English-speaking guide: the Gold Museum, with about 34,000 pieces of pre-Hispanic goldwork and more than 25,000 other pre-Columbian objects; the Casa de la Moneda and the Botero Donation, with works by the renowned Colombian artist Fernando Botero; a panoramic tour of Bolívar Square, with the Primatial Cathedral, the Casa de Nariño, the Liévano Palace and the Palace of Justice; and the ascent to Monserrate. Note: the Gold Museum is closed on Mondays, and the Casa de la Moneda and Botero Donation on Tuesdays.
